name: audit-sim-mutation-correctness
title: Fix simulator clock and command-mutation correctness gaps
description: Close audit findings A-012..A-017: SimulationClock.resume() must not rewind a running clock; command-mode kubectl delete/scale/patch must existence-check against the overlay-aware snapshot (parity with the REST facade) and refuse nameless scale; otel_status must be serialized under a lock; a failed continuous-generation pass must reload published anomalies.csv; _iter_component_rows must guard zero-byte CSVs; and CommandTraceStore.list must clamp a negative/zero limit identically on both backends.
creator: sdelmas
